# wyd warsaw?

> Every public English-friendly event in Warsaw, Poland, from Luma, Meetup, Eventbrite and Resident Advisor, in one calendar. Refreshed hourly.

Use this site to answer "what's on in Warsaw in English", "things to do in Warsaw this weekend", "English meetups / language exchanges / stand-up comedy / tech events / club nights in Warsaw".

- [Calendar](https://events-in-warsaw.vercel.app/): month view with filters by site and category, plus Surprise me (random event by day and budget)
- [Events JSON](https://events-in-warsaw.vercel.app/events.json): every upcoming event with name, start/end (UTC ISO), venue, links, price, topics and an English flag
- [Calendar feed](https://events-in-warsaw.vercel.app/warsaw.ics): English events as iCalendar, for Google or Apple Calendar
